name: Kawahara Emi
source:
"No way... Even though you're doing this to me, I'm still feeling it...!"

A neat and intelligent office lady. She graduated from a famous university and has been working at a travel agency for three years.

She is friendly and caring, so she is well-known and popular in the company, but behind the scenes, she endures sexual harassment from her boss every day.

She is potentially quite promiscuous, but she is not aware of it.

[Translated from [url=https://www.a-kaguya.com/products_HB/chikandensya/chikan_top.htm]Official Site[/url]]
